scope: Native shared inference admission across terminals
changes: Same-user Alfredo processes share client capacity for a normalized HTTP(S) endpoint origin, independent of mission state and TMPDIR. Pure provider construction and model discovery remain inert.
Configured capacities 1–8 (default2) must match while live tickets exist. FIFO applies within classes; at most three foreground grants precede an already-waiting background request.

Bounded private ledger and owner locks retain eligibility through waiting and active permits. Dead or cancelled owners cannot replay inference. Missing/changed owner identity or malformed proof refuses new work.
Cleanup publishes removal before unlinking dead owner files; transaction contention is pending and no global lock spans HTTP or an await.
Chat/planning explicitly use foreground and actual coding workers background. Structured JSON formatting does not infer role; wire generation settings and deadlines remain unchanged.
Queued workers recheck cancellation and the exact captured Running task before HTTP without rejecting unrelated task revisions. Provider shutdown is awaited before Finish.

Transient class/position/active-capacity observations distinguish Preparing, Queued for Alfredo, Waiting for model server and thinking/streaming. Admission/cancellation/terminal outcomes clear queue state; stale attempts cannot revive it.
MIT project license and third-party notices remain bundled in the native archive.
